T: I'd buy that for a dollar.
D: A murdered Detroit cop is rebuilt as a cyborg law enforcer.
P: Serve the snacks every time I'd buy that for a dollar comes on the TV.
S: Popcorn tossed in butter, salt and a heavy dusting of nacho cheese powder (cheddar powder, paprika, garlic).
Smoked salmon on rye with crème fraîche and dill, and mini cucumber cups filled with whipped feta.

Cocktail franks in soft mini buns topped with loose beef coney chilli, yellow mustard and finely diced white onion, served by the trayful. Brown 300g fine beef mince, breaking it up very fine. Add 1 finely diced onion, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml water and simmer 30 minutes until loose and thick. Simmer 24 cocktail franks for 5 minutes. Split 24 mini hot dog buns and warm at 180C for 3 minutes. Fill each with a frank, a spoon of chilli, mustard and diced onion.
M: Natural casing franks griddled, steamed buns, loose coney chilli, yellow mustard and diced white onion.
Murphy's mushroom soup and cheese toasties
the baby food paste they feed him at the station

Silky mushroom soup blitzed with thyme and cream until smooth as paste, served with crisp gruyère and onion toasties for dunking. Soften 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in 40g butter. Add 600g sliced mushrooms and cook 10 minutes until browned. Add 800ml chicken stock and thyme and simmer 20 minutes. Blitz until smooth and stir in 150ml cream. Butter 8 slices sourdough, fill with 150g grated gruyère and thin sliced onion, and toast in a pan for 3 minutes a side. Cut into fingers for dunking.
W: get them before they get you
Chocolate cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, topped with a tall swirl of marshmallow meringue torched into a mushroom cloud.
K: the gang's hangout before the shootout

Ice-cold lager served with a shot of rye whiskey on the side, with a dash of bitters and a lemon twist in the shot. Chill 4 cans or bottles of lager until icy and 4 shot glasses in the freezer. Pour 30ml rye whiskey into each shot glass with a dash of aromatic bitters and a small twist of lemon peel. Serve each shot alongside a cold lager poured into a chilled glass. Sip and chase.

s.note: Buttery popcorn with a heavy cheese powder dusting
s.how: Pop 120g kernels in 2 tbsp oil. Toss with 50g melted butter, then 4 tbsp cheddar cheese powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt until every piece is orange. Serve in a big bowl.

s.note: Smoked salmon rye and whipped feta cucumber cups
s.how: Butter 4 slices rye bread, cut into squares and top with 150g smoked salmon, crème fraîche and dill. Cut 2 cucumbers into thick rounds, scoop a little hollow and fill with 150g feta whipped with a splash of olive oil.

m.note: Franks with loose coney chilli, mustard and diced onion
m.how: Brown 300g beef mince with half a diced onion, 2 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin. Add 200ml water and simmer 20 minutes until loose. Griddle 8 franks, put in steamed buns and top with chilli, mustard and diced white onion.

w.note: Chocolate cupcakes under a torched mushroom-cloud meringue
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 175g self-raising flour, 30g cocoa and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Whisk 3 whites and 150g sugar over hot water, beat to stiff peaks, pipe tall and torch.

d.note: Ice-cold lager served with a shot of rye whiskey on the side, with a dash of bitters and a lemon twist in the shot.
d.how: Chill 4 cans or bottles of lager until icy and 4 shot glasses in the freezer. Pour 30ml rye whiskey into each shot glass with a dash of aromatic bitters and a small twist of lemon peel. Serve each shot alongside a cold lager poured into a chilled glass. Sip and chase.
